protocol: Pre-registered before the first SPORE ingest or detector call on this clip: this probe file, the play_1 manifest entry, the run configuration (surface head + fixed-label veto at .50) and the registration test are committed together. Labels come from visual inspection of a 1 fps contact sheet plus full frames at 10, 20, 30 and 40 s; the query detector was not consulted. The window is a living-room seating area: a round coffee table with an orange game box and playing cards, a gray sofa, a gray armchair, a tan pouf, and a navy blanket on the rug. A 'no' label means the object is not visible anywhere in the window. COCO-covered absence terms (cup, bottle, laptop) test the fixed-label veto; plate and hammer are outside COCO and test its coverage limit.

questions.query: Is there a box on the table?
questions.human_evidence: Orange Scrabble-style game box on the round coffee table throughout the window.

questions.query: Is there a sofa on the floor?
questions.human_evidence: Gray fabric sofa along the left wall, standing on the rug/floor.

questions.query: Is there a chair on the floor?
questions.human_evidence: Gray armchair near the sofa, standing on the rug/floor.

questions.query: Is there a blanket on the floor?
questions.human_evidence: Navy throw blanket spread on the rug/floor throughout the window.

questions.query: Is there a cup on the table?
questions.human_evidence: No cup or glass anywhere in the window. COCO-covered, so the fixed-label veto applies.

questions.query: Is there a bottle on the table?
questions.human_evidence: No bottle anywhere in the window. COCO-covered, so the fixed-label veto applies.

questions.query: Is there a laptop on the table?
questions.human_evidence: No laptop anywhere in the window. COCO-covered, so the fixed-label veto applies.

questions.query: Is there a plate on the table?
questions.human_evidence: No plate anywhere in the window. COCO has no plate class, so the veto cannot cover this term.

questions.query: Is there a hammer on the table?
questions.human_evidence: No hammer anywhere in the window. COCO has no hammer class, so the veto cannot cover this term.

questions.query: Is the box still on the table?
questions.human_evidence: The game box remains on the coffee table at 40 s.

questions.query: Is the sofa still on the floor?
questions.human_evidence: The sofa does not leave the seating area.
The box stays on the coffee table for the whole window.
The sofa is static in the seating area.
